PART I


Book I. The History Of A Family


Chapter I.

The opening chapter carries a real paragraph of ordinary prose so the splitter
has a genuine body to fold the stacked Part and Book labels into as one unit.


Chapter II.

The second chapter continues with another plain paragraph of prose that stands
on its own and is never mistaken for a heading, a divider, or a contents entry.


Book II. An Unfortunate Gathering


Chapter I.

The gathering begins the second book with prose of its own, its per-book chapter
numeral reset back to one exactly as the real source repeats it in the body.

Chapter I.
